name: line-shadow-text
blurb: Underline glows and animates beneath text.
description: A colored line shadow beneath text that pulses or traces with a glow effect, non-interactive and continuous.
use_when: Accent headings or feature text that needs underline emphasis.
avoid_when: Small or body text — shadow adds visual clutter.
a11y: Purely decorative. No keyboard or focus interaction.
